scenario: One person is selling a couch, loveseat, chair, and ottoman set for $550.0, while another person is keen to purchase it. The set of furniture is described as being incredibly comfortable. The seller's wife wishes to upgrade to a new, stiffer couch, hence the sale. Despite some light staining from life's little incidents, the set is in great condition. The comfort of the furniture is particularly emphasized by the seller.
learner_goal: You are the buyer for this item, with a target price of $418.0. If you end up purchasing it for a price significantly higher than the target, you will be penalized. However, if you manage to acquire it for less than the target price, you will receive a bonus.
partner_goal: As the seller for this item, your target price is set at $312.0. Please be aware that a penalty will be incurred if the item is sold for a price significantly below the target price. However, you will receive a bonus if you manage to sell it for more than the target price.

transcript.speaker: William Brown
transcript.content: Hey Ava — it’s William from the food festival. That set sounds perfect; as a chef I live for a couch I can crash on after a long shift. I can pick it up this weekend and pay cash — would you take $375 for the whole set given the light staining and immediate pickup?

transcript.speaker: Ava Martinez
transcript.content: Hey William — great to hear from you! $375 works for me. I’m around this weekend; can you pick up Saturday around 2pm? I can help load it into your truck and cash on pickup is fine. If that doesn’t work, Sunday afternoon is possible too. Tell me what time and I’ll send my address. Also, fair warning: it’s ridiculously comfy — you’ll forgive the little stains. :)

transcript.speaker: William Brown
transcript.content: Saturday at 2pm works great. I’ll bring cash and my truck — thanks for offering to help load. Please send your address and any loading/parking notes. See you then!

transcript.speaker: Ava Martinez
transcript.content: Perfect — my address is 214 Maple St, Apt 3B. There’s usually room to fit a truck in the driveway; if not, street parking right in front works fine. If you can pull into the driveway it’ll make loading easiest — the couch and loveseat are in the living room and we can roll them out through the front door. There are two small steps up to the porch. I’ll be there to help load; if you have moving blankets or straps, bring them to protect the fabric. Text me when you’re about 10 minutes away and I’ll meet you outside. See you Saturday at 2 — can’t wait for you to experience how ridiculously comfy it is! — Ava (they/them)
